fields.description:
Billing Notes is a long text field stuck inside a two-column section, so it renders narrow and ugly. Investigate a custom component that can render a field outside a field section.

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* What was tried and failed on Aug 17: making Billing Notes a two-column-width field inside the two-column Billing Details section — not possible ('Are we able to make it a two column field or no? No'). Then a separate one-column field section below Billing Details holding just Billing Notes — Kobi: 'It's not pretty, but that's one way to do it... Uh, it looks like it's broken though. I don't like that.'

* Root cause: 'the field section is requiring you to specify if it's going to be single column or double column. It governs that entire area. So it's not going to work.'

* The decision was to park it. Kobi: 'it's fine. Leave it for now as is and we'll come back to it. I think there might be a way to do other custom components to have a field outside of the section. But we'll deal with that later.'

* Scope is an INVESTIGATION, most likely a small LWC. Do not treat this as buildable work until someone confirms the approach.

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* Also unresolved: whether a field section label can be removed at all, which the workaround depended on. Kobi: 'can we remove a label? Do we need to— I don't remember if we need to have a label.'

* Is this worth an LWC at all, or is a narrow Billing Notes field just acceptable? Taryn's concern was 'it's going to be quite thick' if the client writes a lot. Low priority either way.

=== NOTES ===

* Sourced from the Aug 17 transcript.

=== SOURCE ===

* Aug 17 call — attempted, failed, parked

Dependencies: None

Owner (proposed): TBD

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
